plan.title: [framework-gap] Antigravity PreToolUse hook unconditionally denies ask_question because normalizeAgyHookPayload drops toolCall.args.questions

narratives.Description: [framework-gap] Antigravity PreToolUse hook unconditionally denies ask_question because normalizeAgyHookPayload drops toolCall.args.questions
narratives.Overview:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `normalizeAgyHookPayload` forwards structured arguments from agy `toolCall.args` onto `tool_input`, including `questions` (each `{ question, options: string[], is_multi_select }`), not only the five string keys.
- [ ] `toolInputRecord` falls back to `toolCall.args` as well as `toolCall.arguments`.
- [ ] An agy `ask_question` whose final two options are `Discuss` and `Back` is allowed by the question-hatch gate, and one without them is still denied with `question-hatch-missing`.
- [ ] `decideSpendRecommendGate` reads the options of an agy `ask_question`.
- [ ] `ask_question` has an entry in `AGY_TOOL_DISPOSITIONS`.
- [ ] A test drives `decideHook` with a real-shaped agy `ask_question` payload for both the allow and deny cases.

issueCommentThread.body:
Rewriting the body to criteria-only for ingest (taking it through merge for 0.132.1 with #7438, #7440, #7416; no arc: root cause and files are named). Prior body quoted below for the audit trail.

<details><summary>Prior body</summary>

## Summary

Antigravity PreToolUse hook unconditionally denies ask_question because normalizeAgyHookPayload drops toolCall.args.questions

## Context

Directive 0.132.0 on Antigravity (agy 1.5.18, win32) with live PreToolUse hooks active (internal benchmark evidence (private)). Calling Antigravity native ask_question with Discuss and Back as the final two options.

## Expected behavior

normalizeAgyHookPayload forwards toolCall.args.questions (and options if present) onto tool_input so extractQuestionOptionGroups reads the option labels, decideQuestionHatchGate allows valid Discuss/Back menus, and decideSpendRecommendGate inspects spend-shaped options.

## Actual behavior / gap

PreToolUse unconditionally denies ask_question with question-hatch-missing ('Directive denied ask_question: structured question missing hard-stop hatch') even when Discuss and Back are the final two options. Root cause: isQuestionToolName('ask_question') matches QUESTION_TOOL_NAMES ('askquestion'), normalizeAgyHookPayload in hooks/classify/agy-wire.js only copies 5 string keys (CommandLine, Path, Content, Target, Replacement) from toolCall.args into tool_input (producing tool_input: {}), and toolInputRecord in hooks/classify/payload.js only falls back to toolCall.arguments (not toolCall.args). extractQuestionOptionGroups therefore returns [] on every AGY ask_question call.

## Session notes

Observed in live AGY 1.5.18 session under flat SessionStart hook schema (Refs #7440, #7346, #5373). Also note ask_question is not listed in AGY_TOOL_DISPOSITIONS in agy-wire.js, and Antigravity ask_question passes questions: [{ question, options: string[], is_multi_select }] inside toolCall.args. Source: internal benchmark evidence (private).

---
_Filed via `deft feedback:file` from a directive consumer project (Refs #1709 value-feedback gap escalation)._
